verdict.rationale: DeepSeek's API is inherently natural-language driven (chat completions) and documents tool/function calling plus an early 'agent harness' preview, letting natural-language prompts trigger actions when paired with agent frameworks like Claude Code or OpenCode. However, evidence is API/backend-centric rather than showing a first-party consumer interface where natural language directly 'operates' the product end-to-end. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a native chat/agent UI or CLI where natural-language commands directly control DeepSeek's own product surface (not just via third-party agent tools), and independent hands-on confirmation of agentic command execution.
